$comment: Evaluation set for the fleet assistant (npm run eval). Each expected value is computed by SQL at run time, as the same user, so it always matches today's data. match: number (all values must appear in the answer, any locale format), text (any of the accepted strings), month (a YYYY-MM month by name or number), refusal (no chart shown: the assistant says it cannot answer). proposal (Phase 5b): the assistant must propose an FRC for the vehicle, with the right can_confirm, and never open it.
